headline: Bank Danamon signs MoU with AIGL to explore AI agents for collections and telesales
body: Bank Danamon Indonesia and Advance Intelligence Group (AIGL) signed a MoU to explore two AI agents for collections and telesales. The agents would support selected customer interactions through voice and text channels, with governance and oversight from Danamon’s teams.
note: Collections and telesales are customer-facing work, so the governance terms in the MoU matter as much as what the agents can do.

evidence.text: Bank Danamon Indonesia has partnered with Advance Intelligence Group (AIGL) to explore how AI agents can support its banking operations.
The two companies signed a MoU to explore the potential use of two AI agents for collections and telesales.
The agents would support selected customer interactions through voice and text channels, with governance and oversight from Danamon’s teams.
The partnership forms part of Danamon’s broader plans to integrate artificial intelligence (AI) across its business.
